title: Arquiteto de soluções sap
description:
Oportunidade de Carreira: Arquiteto de Soluções SAP no Grupo LPJ
Sobre o Grupo LPJ:
Com 20 anos de história, o Grupo LPJ é uma holding de consultorias com soluções especializadas em estratégia de negócios, sistemas SAP, gestão de processos, tecnologia e compliance tributário. Formado por empresas com expertise complementar, o grupo é parceiro de grandes marcas e reconhecido por entregar resultados consistentes, com inovação, agilidade e foco em pessoas. Aqui, acreditamos que o nosso maior diferencial está no talento e na dedicação dos nossos times.
As empresas BASE e SOURCE são especialistas em soluções SAP. Juntas, asseguram tanto a implementação quanto a sustentação e otimização de sistemas críticos, garantindo que os clientes tenham segurança, performance e evolução constante. Com forte atuação em tecnologia, gestão de processos e metodologias ágeis, são ambientes ideais para quem busca crescimento técnico e novos desafios em projetos estratégicos.
Sobre o perfil:
Como Arquiteto de Soluções SAP, será responsável por compreender demandas de negócio e traduzi-las em propostas técnicas e comerciais robustas, viáveis e alinhadas à estratégia da organização. O arquiteto será o elo entre as áreas técnicas (consultores e GPs), áreas de negócio e o GDE (Gestor de Desenvolvimento Estratégico), garantindo sinergia, clareza e valor nas soluções apresentadas — desde o desenho até a entrega final.
Responsabilidades Principais:
Entendimento de demanda: Analisar documentos enviados por clientes ou realizar alinhamentos diretos para mapear necessidades técnicas e de negócio;
Desenho de soluções SAP: Modelar arquiteturas para soluções SAP (RISE, GROW, BTP, CX, S/4 HANA, Success Factors, entre outras) com autonomia, considerando inovação, viabilidade técnica e custo-benefício;
Documentação estratégica: Produzir documentos técnicos completos, mapas de batalha, cronogramas (macro e micro), e artefatos de apoio ao time de delivery, sempre alinhados ao Gerente de Projetos (GP);
Integração interfuncional: Estabelecer sinergia entre os times de delivery, consultores, GP e GDE, assegurando o entendimento integral da solução e seus impactos;
Elaboração da proposta final: Consolidar e apresentar a proposta técnica e comercial final, validada com o GP e o GDE;
Respostas a RFPs: Ser responsável direto pela elaboração de respostas técnicas e comerciais a RFPs (Requests for Proposal), garantindo assertividade, alinhamento com os objetivos do cliente e diferenciação competitiva. Requisitos:
Experiência comprovada com múltiplas soluções SAP;
Experiência comprovada em modelar arquiteturas para soluções SAP (RISE, GROW, BTP, CX, S/4 HANA, Success Factors, entre outras);
Domínio em elaboração de propostas técnicas e comerciais;
Familiaridade com frameworks como SAP Activate, Clean Core, Signavio, SAP BTP e Lean IX;
Capacidade de comunicação clara com perfis técnicos e executivos;
Experiência com resposta a RFPs e participação em ciclos de pré-venda;

title: Database administrator
description:
We are looking for a skilled Senior Database Reliability Engineer to manage high-performance database and Big Data systems that support our innovative customer experience Saa S platform.
Skills Needed:
5+ years of extensive experience in database technologies primarily Postgre SQL 9.6.x or higher.
Experience in Postgre SQL partitioning, auditing, performance improvement, query optimization, index management etc.
Experience in supporting Postgre SQL databases in AWS or other public clouds. Ability to provide on-call support on a rotation schedule.

Solid understanding of various infrastructure components: servers, storage, and networking, application and database performance metrics.
Knowledge and experience with Cassandra or similar No-SQL data stores is a huge plus.
SQL development experience.
Proficiency with scripting languages like Bash/Golang/Python. Please share the copy of resume at if interested.
Regards,
Dhirendra

title: Representante técnico de vendas
description:
A Caltec é uma indústria brasileira do ramo mineral, localizada em Itaperuçu-PR. Com 80 anos de história é especialista na transformação de minerais brutos em produtos com engenharia aplicada, que geram soluções inovadoras e sustentáveis para diversos mercados.
Atua em setores como siderurgia, celulose, açúcar, agronegócio e logística. Com um parque industrial moderno e mineração própria, movimenta mais de 1,2 milhão de toneladas anuais, possui logística integrada e forte investimento em pesquisa, ciência e tecnologia, a Caltec é referência nacional em ferticorretivos e pioneira na técnica da Ferticorreção, alia evolução tecnológica e sustentabilidade promovendo eficiência produtiva com responsabilidade ambiental.
Atividades:
●Gestão de Relacionamento: Realizar o planejamento estratégico de visitas via CRM, garantindo a execução rigorosa das rotas e o cumprimento das metas de atendimento.
●Expansão de Mercado: Gerir e prospectar carteiras de clientes de forma ativa, identificando novas oportunidades de negócio na região.
●Suporte Técnico e Capacitação: Ministrar treinamentos técnicos e prestar assistência especializada tanto para canais de distribuição quanto para o cliente final.
●Desenvolvimento de Campo: Identificar, preparar e conduzir áreas de teste/demonstração após a formalização das negociações.
●Geração de Demanda: Apresentar resultados de performance através da instalação de campos demonstrativos (lado a lado/demoplots), consolidando a autoridade técnica da marca.
Requisitos e qualificações:
●Formação Superior completa em Agronomia.
●Sólido conhecimento técnico nas culturas predominantes da região.
●Domínio do mercado de Fertilizantes e nutrição vegetal.
●Experiência comprovada em vendas de insumos agrícolas.

title: Business development manager - latam focus
description:

title: Software engineering manager
description:
ABOUT US
Syniti, part of Capgemini, tackles the hardest work in data for the world’s largest organizations. We combine intelligent software with deep data expertise to help the Fortune2000 tackle complex data challenges and drive measurable business outcomes with business-ready data.Syniti’s Data First strategy transforms data from an afterthought into a strategic asset—unlocking insights, reducing risk, and fueling growth. With over 5,000 successful projects, we support the full data lifecycle through a unified platform for migration, quality, replication, matching, master data management, analytics, governance, and strategy. Operating globally across industries, Syniti’s award-winning software, expert consultants give enterprises a unique edge in managing and maximizing their data.Syniti’s cloud-native platform sets new standards in enterprise data management, combining powerful Saa S solutions with deep domain expertise. Designed for agility and scale, our technology helps customers accelerate digital transformation, drive innovation, and make confident decisions with trusted data. Every product enhancement is built to solve real business challenges—empowering organizations to unlock value from their data faster and more effectively.THE ROLE
The Manager I of Engineering plays a key leadership role, directly managing a small team of software engineers. This role is responsible for ensuring timely delivery of high-quality software projects, fostering a collaborative and inclusive team culture, and supporting the professional growth of engineers.
In addition to leading day-to-day execution, this manager contributes to tactical decision-making, participates in architectural discussions, and ensures engineering efforts are aligned with project goals. They collaborate closely with product, design, and cross-functional stakeholders to deliver solutions that support Syniti’s broader mission.WHAT YOU WILL DO
• Manage and support a team of software engineers, ensuring projects are delivered on time and within scope.
• Provide coaching, mentorship, and regular performance feedback to support individual growth.
• Guide the team in applying engineering best practices, including code reviews, testing, and secure development.
• Participate in architectural and technical design discussions, ensuring sound engineering decisions.
• Collaborate closely with product and cross-functional teams to align priorities and deliver value.
• Help shape a positive and inclusive team culture that fosters engagement, learning, and innovation.
• Identify and address delivery risks, blockers, or process gaps within the team’s scope.
• Contribute to hiring and onboarding of new engineers, and support team scaling efforts.WHAT IT TAKES
• Proven experience as a team lead or first-line engineering manager in a software development environment.
• Strong technical foundation in modern software development (e.g., C#, Go, React, Type Script, AWS).
• Familiarity with agile development methodologies, Dev Ops practices, and software delivery processes.
• Excellent communication and collaboration skills across technical and non-technical stakeholders.
• Demonstrated ability to coach, mentor, and support the growth of engineering team members.
• Experience participating in technical design, architecture reviews, and secure development practices.
• Comfortable working in a fast-paced, distributed, and cross-functional environment.Be fully aligned to our core values:
• Think Big - Be courageous and bold. Aspire to greatness. Relentlessly pursue market innovation. Set the standard by which others follow. Create solutions that have a meaningful impact. Solve the challenges our customers don’t know they have.
• Be Curious - Be a lifelong learner. Seek out new ideas to serve customers. Understand our competition and the world. Be permanently dissatisfied with the status quo. Challenge preconceptions. Focus on the future rather than yesterday.
• Take Action - Be the first. Don’t wait. Take accountability. Inspire others by doing. Fail fast and learn from mistakes. Make a difference every day.
• Stronger Together - Respect, trust and look out for each other. Celebrate diverse perspectives. Listen. Build connections and belonging. Act with integrity. Give back. One Syniti family.WHAT WE OFFER
• Trust in your talent. At Syniti you will find a supportive environment and access to learning tools, but micromanagement is not our style.
• Growth. We are growing rapidly and steadily solving the biggest challenges enterprise companies are faced with today. There was never a better time to join and grow with us. Most importantly you will have the chance to shape our journey and share in our success story.
• Support. We all rely on each other and enable each other to be successful. You won’t stand alone.
• Curiosity and genuine interest in you. We all have our different stories, all equally fascinating with each depicting a different journey and we want to hear them all.
• Recognition. We are the sum of individual achievements, and we always take the time to celebrate them.
• An open organisation. Titles don’t define access at Syniti. We stay humble regardless of where we sit in the organisation. We want to hear every voice, listen to all the ideas and make sure everyone’s work is seen and valued.

title: Senior database engineer / lead dba (db2 luw & cloud migration) – bilingual (en/pt)
description:

Mainframe DB2 LUW

Advanced Tuning:Expert-level ability to diagnose and resolve complex SQL performance issues.
Location:Remote friendly—we value your skillset over your physical location.

title: Landholder and reforestation delivery manager
description:
About Nature CoNature Co delivers nature-based solutions (Nb S) for investors, corporates and other purpose driven organisations to scale up action on climate change and biodiversity loss. We specialise in nature-based project development including reforestation, agroforestry, farmer managed natural regeneration and mangrove restoration. Nature Co has extensive expertise in working with local communities to protect and restore natural ecosystems through participation in the global voluntary carbon market.
Nature Co is currently implementing a large-scale reforestation project in Brazil for the generation of verified carbon credits.
We are a diverse, mission-driven team that values inclusion, integrity, and innovation. Nature Co is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer, committed to building an equitable and inclusive workplace for all.Role and responsibilities
The Landholder and Reforestation Delivery Manager is the primary field-based interface with landholders, communities, reforestation contractors, and other local stakeholders for Nature Co’s projects in Brazil. This position will build and manage a pipeline of landholders interested in reforestation, lead outreach and onboarding, coordinate site inspections, lead the collection of relevant data required for carbon standard checks, and lead signature of landholder agreements. The role will also play a key role in ensuring compliance (contracts and carbon standards) as well as coordinate schedules between landholders and contractors for the implementation of reforestation activities. This will include confirming site readiness, conducting periodic field quality audits, documenting and tracking progress, and resolving issues that could delay delivery or degrade quality.
The role requires a strong combination stakeholder engagement and management experience, and a commitment to quality and impact. The role requires extensive travel and field work across Minas Gerais, Bahia and Espírito Santo.Primary roles and responsibilities include:
Landholder engagement, onboarding, and pipeline management
Map priority municipalities and referral partner networks (city governments, co-ops, farmer associations, NGOs); plan and run outreach activities, events and information sessions.
Manage the landholder onboarding process (identify → qualify → onboard → contract), using CRM/trackers to keep status, documents and next actions current.
Prepare clear information packs (benefits, obligations, timelines) and respond to inquiries in a timely, professional manner.
Maintain ongoing landholder relationship management to support retention, satisfaction, and smooth site access throughout implementation.
Eligibility, due diligence & agreements
Coordinate site inspections and initial diagnostics in consultation with other team members (parcel boundaries, vegetation status, access, water, risks).
Support land tenure verification and FPIC documentation
Lead closure of contract signatures.
Maintain organized repository of all landholder records within Nature Co’s data management system
(land titles, eligibility documents, contracts, site maps, inspection notes, photos, consultation records).
Reforestation delivery enablement
Translate signed landholder agreements into implementation-ready site plans (site-specific scope, access instructions, constraints, schedule windows).
Align field schedules with landholders and contractors to ensure access, minimize disruption to farm activities, and maintain trust and cooperation.
Support in the delivery of field delivery progress from contractors by site (start/finish dates, activities completed, challenges, next steps), and escalate issues early (access, weather delays, input shortages, labor constraints).
Support in monitoring reforestation activities (during and post planting) and coordinate, where required, rapid response with contractors/landholders (grazing, fire risk, pests, drought stress).
Stakeholder engagement and safeguards
Plan and document stakeholder consultations and community meetings in accordance with Nature Co policies and procedures (agendas, attendance lists, minutes, photos).
Support the team in the operation of the grievance mechanism: receiving grievances and responding in accordance with the Nature Co grievance mechanism.
Maintain landholder contact and ensure landholder information is kept up to date.
Coordinate access, for other project staff and contractors as required.
Reporting
Lead or assist the development of formal monthly, quarterly, and annual project implementation reports for internal and external stakeholders in line with contract and/or carbon standard requirements.
Prepare ad hoc reports, documents, and presentations for internal and external stakeholders.
Teamwork and culture
Support the management of a cross-functional, international team, fostering collaboration and ensuring that project milestones and goals are met.
Stay current on emerging best practices in Nb S and carbon projects; proactively share insights across the organisation and with partners.Skills and attributes
To perform successfully in this role, you will have:
A minimum of five (5) years of experience in reforestation projects with direct contact with rural landholders and reforestation planting service providers.
Degree in forest engineering, agronomy, ecology, or environmental science.
Intermediate English and native Portuguese language skills
Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to engage confidently across cultures and stakeholder groups.
Strong project management skills, including experience managing timelines, deliverables, and working across multidisciplinary teams.
A proactive, self-starting approach with the ability to anticipate problems, adapt quickly, and take initiative under limited supervision.
A collaborative mindset and ability to lead and motivate internal teams and external partners
Ability to provide strategic and technical guidance across complex, multi-stakeholder projects.
Strong organisational skills and attention to detail in documentation and reporting.
A positive, energetic personality with resilience and drive to see projects through to delivery.Extensive travel within Brazil is a requirement to perform this position.Location
Remote, with residence in Minas Gerais, Espirito Santo, or BahiaSubmission instructions
Email CV and brief cover letter to with subject: Landholder and Reforestation Delivery Manager
Submission deadline: 30 March 2026

title: Marketing specialist
description:
About Mosaic Puzzles
Mosaic Puzzles is a jigsaw puzzle company based in Alpharetta, Georgia. We design and build unique wooden puzzles where every piece is part of the story. Our collections blend intricate art, clever cut designs, and premium craftsmanship.We’re a fast-paced, growing startup led by former Uber and Amazon team members, and we’re looking for someone excited to move quickly and contribute ideas that make a real impact.Check our website for more information: Overview
We’re looking for a creative, detail-oriented, and results-drivenMarketing Specialistto join our team. This role combines strong execution skills with analytical thinking and excellent project management.This role supports the planning and execution of marketing initiatives across multiple channels including email, SMS, social media, and website content. The ideal candidate is highly organized, comfortable working with data, and able to manage multiple marketing projects simultaneously.You will work closely with other company departments to execute campaigns, analyze performance, and continuously improve how customers discover and engage with our products.Key ResponsibilitiesMarketing Strategy & Campaign Execution
Assist in the planning and execution of marketing campaigns across email, SMS, social media, website content, and seasonal promotions.
Coordinate campaign timelines and marketing calendars to support product launches, seasonal initiatives, and brand campaigns.
Support lifecycle marketing initiatives including newsletters, SMS campaigns, product launches, and promotional moments.
Collaborate with the team to identify marketing opportunities and propose ideas that improve campaign performance.Content & Brand Communication
Write clear, engaging copy for newsletters, SMS campaigns, social media, blog posts, and other marketing materials.
Maintain a consistent brand voice across all marketing channels.
Coordinate content calendars aligned with seasonal themes, product launches, and marketing priorities.
Monitor social media conversations and user-generated content to identify engagement opportunities.Digital Marketing & Analytics
Track and analyze campaign performance across email, SMS, social media, and website channels.
Interpret marketing data and provide actionable insights to improve campaign performance.
Assist with SEO initiatives including keyword research, content optimization, and website improvements.
Support customer surveys and feedback analysis to help inform product and marketing decisions.Project Management & Cross-Functional Collaboration
Manage multiple marketing projects and deadlines simultaneously.
Work with designers, photographers, videographers, and other cross-functional partners to prepare creative briefs and campaign assets.
Ensure marketing initiatives are delivered on time and aligned with campaign goals.
Maintain a high level of organization and attention to detail across all marketing initiatives.Requirements
Fluent in English (C1 level or higher). Exceptional written and spoken communication is essential.
Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Communications, Business, or a related field.
3+ years of experience in marketing, digital marketing, or content marketing.
Solid understanding ofdigital marketing analytics and performance tracking.
Strong organizational and project management skills.
Experience working with email and SMS marketing platforms such as Mailchimp, Attentive, or similar tools.
Ability to manage multiple projects and shifting priorities in a fast-paced environment.
Proactive mindset with the ability to suggest ideas and take initiative.
Strong copywriting skills with a knack for storytelling and brand voice.
Experience managing social media accounts and understanding platform best practices.
Solid understanding of digital marketing principles, including email marketing and social content strategy.
Knowledge of SEO is a plus.How to Apply
Candidates must submit their resumes in English. Applications submitted in other languages will not be considered.Mosaic Cultural Values Alignment
The ideal candidate will embody Mosaic’s cultural values, including:
Owner’s Mindset: Working hard, helping others, and proactively contributing.
Process Orientation: Showing your work and thinking ahead.
Moving Quickly: Taking initiative and being proactive.
Taking Responsibility: Owning your actions.
Valuing Ideas Over Hierarchy: Contributing creatively and openly.
Continuous Improvement: Always seeking better ways to work.
Doing the Right Thing: Acting with integrity.
Believing in Meritocracy: Recognizing and rewarding performance.
Resourcefulness: Finding cost-effective and practical solutions.

title: Head of gtm & growth | valere evolve
description:
About Valere Evolve
Valere Evolve is an AI transformation platform that accelerates AI maturity by unifying workforce education, custom development, knowledge capture, and autonomous execution into a single integrated system. Built on three connected pillars — Learn, Build, and Scale — each phase feeds directly into the next. Learning prepares the workforce. Labs builds the systems. Dactic captures institutional knowledge. Conducto orchestrates execution at scale. The result is a continuous transformation loop rather than a stack of disconnected tools and vendors. One platform. From ambition to AI-native operations.
The Role
As Head of GTM & Growth, you are the commercial engine behind Valere Evolve. You will own the full go-to-market strategy and growth execution — from market positioning and pipeline creation to partnership development and revenue scaling. This is not a planning role. You will be expected to build, launch, and iterate in market with the same hands-on urgency that defines the product itself.
You bring demonstrated experience taking AI products and platforms to market, using AI-native tools to scale your own work, and a track record of growing user bases through high-leverage execution. You have done this before. You know what it takes to move a technical platform from early adopters to scaled commercial traction, and you know how to do it with a lean, intelligent team.
This role requires the ability to execute across multiple simultaneous growth motions — and the strategic judgment to know when to lean into each one based on what the market is telling you.
Impact You Will Have
Own Market Entry & Expansion: Define and execute the GTM strategy across target segments, verticals, and channels — translating Valere Evolve's platform vision into a repeatable, scalable motion that drives pipeline and accelerates time-to-revenue
Build the Growth Engine: Design and personally run the growth infrastructure — outbound sequences, nurture flows, content strategy, and conversion optimization — leveraging AI-native tools to operate at a velocity that outpaces traditional GTM teams
Drive Strategic Partnerships: Identify, develop, and close high-leverage partnerships with channel partners, systems integrators, enterprise resellers, and platform ecosystems that unlock distribution and accelerate adoption at scale — structuring agreements that embed platform value directly into partner programs as a retention and growth mechanism
Expand from Within: Develop and execute playbooks that convert active client relationships into platform adoption, creating organic expansion from within accounts that are already experiencing Valere's value firsthand
Translate Product Into Commercial Narrative: Work closely with product and delivery to develop positioning, messaging, and sales enablement that clearly articulates the value of the Learn → Build → Scale loop to enterprise buyers
Convert Strategy to Revenue: Build the frameworks, KPIs, and real-time dashboards that connect GTM activity to pipeline health, conversion rates, expansion revenue, and customer acquisition cost
Scale the User Base: Execute demand generation and account-based programs that grow the active user base across direct, partner-led, and paid acquisition channels — with measurable growth targets tied to platform adoption milestones Key Responsibilities
GTM Strategy & Multi-Motion Execution — Own the full go-to-market roadmap including ICP definition, pricing frameworks, and launch execution. You will design and operate across multiple distinct growth motions simultaneously, building the systems to manage, measure, and optimize each one with clarity and speed
Partnership Development & Distribution — Source and structure strategic partnerships that create meaningful distribution leverage — including experience embedding platform capabilities and educational content directly into partner programs, proposals, and client engagements. Own the full partnership lifecycle from identification through activation and ongoing revenue contribution
Account Expansion & Organic Growth — Build and execute the internal playbooks, enablement materials, and account triggers that convert existing relationships into platform adoption and drive organic growth from within active engagements. Identify the signals that indicate expansion readiness and move on them
Targeted Outbound & Enterprise Penetration — Execute precision outbound campaigns targeting key individuals and internal champions inside large organizations. Build the entry-point strategy, manage the champion relationship, and develop the expansion motion that follows initial adoption to grow platform footprint organically from the inside out
Paid Acquisition & Influence-Driven Demand — Build and manage a paid acquisition strategy that drives platform awareness and qualified demand at scale — including the identification and activation of credible voices in the AI and enterprise transformation space to amplify reach and accelerate top-of-funnel growth
AI-Native Operations — Build and operate GTM workflows using AI-native tools — from prospecting automation and pipeline intelligence to content generation and deal acceleration. You use the tools. You don't delegate the tools.
Revenue & Pipeline Ownership — Work directly with sales and leadership to manage pipeline, forecast accuracy, and growth targets. You are accountable to the number.
Market Intelligence — Continuously monitor the competitive landscape, buyer behavior, and adoption trends to sharpen positioning and identify untapped growth vectors across all active acquisition channels
Cross-Functional Alignment — Serve as the connective layer between product, delivery, and commercial teams — ensuring GTM motion is tightly integrated with product roadmap, customer outcomes, and client-facing team capabilities What We Look For
Experience: 4+ years in GTM, growth, or commercial leadership roles, with at least 2 years of demonstrated experience bringing AI products or platforms to market in a hands-on capacity
AI Product GTM (Required): Proven track record of taking AI-native products or platforms from early traction to scaled commercial adoption. You understand the buyer journey, the objections, the trust barriers, and what actually moves enterprise deals forward
AI-Native Operator (Required): You actively use and scale your work with AI tools. You have built GTM workflows, systems, and processes powered by AI automation — not as a pilot, but as standard operating procedure
Multi-Motion GTM Execution (Required): Demonstrated ability to design and run multiple simultaneous growth motions — partner-led distribution, account expansion, precision outbound, and paid acquisition — and the strategic maturity to resource and prioritize across them as market conditions evolve
Partnership Builder: Demonstrated ability to develop and close strategic partnerships that create real distribution leverage — including experience structuring agreements where platform access or educational content is embedded as a core component of the partnership value proposition
Account Expansion Experience: Proven ability to convert existing client or customer relationships into product adoption — building the internal plays and triggers that drive organic growth from within active accounts
Enterprise Outbound & Champion Development: Hands-on experience running targeted outbound to individual practitioners and decision-influencers inside large organizations, with the ability to build internal champions and develop the expansion motion that follows initial adoption
Paid Acquisition & Influencer Marketing: Working knowledge of paid acquisition strategy in B2 B and B2 B2 C contexts, including performance measurement, creator or partner identification, and building programs that sustain organic reach alongside paid investment
Strategic Mindset with Execution Bias: You can build the roadmap and execute it in the same week. You are equally comfortable in a board-level positioning conversation and building the outbound sequence that follows it
Data-Driven Growth: Fluency in GTM analytics, funnel metrics, and revenue operations. You build dashboards, track what matters, and adjust based on signal — not assumption
Communication: Ability to translate complex platform capabilities into compelling narratives for enterprise buyers, partners, and executive stakeholders across every channel and motion
Builder Mentality: You don't wait for a team or a budget to grow. You find leverage, build fast, and scale what works
Genuine Enthusiasm for AI: Deep curiosity about the evolving AI landscape and a conviction that AI transformation is the defining enterprise challenge of this decade How to Apply
To be considered for this role, all applicants must submit a brief Loom or video recording (5 minutes or less) shared with , including two things:
A personal introduction — who you are, what drives you, and why this role and this moment in AI transformation excites you
A concrete GTM example — walk us through a specific product or platform you've taken to market. We want the real story: the motion you chose, the obstacles you hit, how you adapted, and the measurable outcome. Slide decks and polished narratives are not what we're looking for. Show us how you think and execute. Submissions without a video will not be reviewed. We are not evaluating production quality — we are evaluating clarity of thought, commercial instinct, and evidence of hands-on execution.

title: Portuguese language specialist
description:
i Merit seeks detail-oriented and skilled Gen AI Data Annotation Analysts to join our global remote teams. Analysts will perform annotations across various modalities—including text, image, and video—to deliver high-quality datasets essential for training and refining cutting- edge Generative AI models.
Role Responsibilities:
Annotate high-quality training data across text, image, and video modalities, adhering strictly to provided project guidelines.
Generate accurate data annotation as per project requirements.
Apply critical thinking and logical decision-making when handling ambiguous data scenarios.
Proactively identify and report annotation tool issues, bugs, or potential improvements.
Collaborate with Language Leads, Project Managers, and technical teams to ensure annotation tasks meet quality standards. Skills & Competencies:
Exceptional attention to detail and strong analytical skills for identifying inaccuracies and ensuring annotation precision.
Proficiency in adapting to various project specifications and guidelines.
Excellent reading comprehension skills in the target language equivalent to CEFR B2 and above.
Strong organizational skills, capable of managing multiple annotation tasks efficiently and independently.
Comfort handling social media content, demonstrating proficiency at a minimum of understanding PII and NER related content.
Ability to quickly learn and navigate diverse annotation platforms and tools. Requirements:
Bachelor's degree/ diploma or equivalent educational qualification.
Minimum of 1-2 years of experience in annotation tasks, linguistic data handling, or related AI/ML projects.
Demonstrated experience working with data annotation tools and software platforms.
Strong understanding of language nuances, including grammar, style, and cultural context.
Ability to adapt quickly to changing project directions and fast-paced work environments.
Previous experience creating or annotating complex data specifically for Large Language Model (LLM) training.
Familiarity with annotation projects involving sensitive or nuanced content.
Prior exposure to Generative AI technologies and principles. What We Offer:
An innovative and supportive global working environment.
Opportunities for continuous learning and growth.
Competitive compensation and remote working arrangements.
Engagement in impactful projects at the forefront of AI technology. Join i Merit to be part of shaping high-quality datasets powering the next generation of
Generative AI solutions. If precision, critical analysis, and innovation excite you, we encourage
you to apply!

Ética profissional e inteligência emocional para lidar com diferentes perfis de clientes e pares.

description:

Experiência com desenvolvimento de aplicações web;

Contrato PJ, 8/h por dia, Home Office. Interessados candidatar-se pelo Linked In respondendo as perguntas de seleção.

title: Legal assistant
description:
Position OverviewGemean is seeking a highly organized and detail-oriented Legal Assistant to support our legal, forensic, and investigative teams. In this role, you will assist with case preparation, document management, and coordination across legal and investigative matters. You will work closely with attorneys, analysts, and project managers to ensure efficient case handling, accurate documentation, and timely communication. This position plays an important role in maintaining operational efficiency and supporting complex litigation, investigations, and regulatory matters.
Key Responsibilities
Assist legal teams with preparation and organization of case files, documentation, and supporting materials
Manage legal documents, correspondence, and records while maintaining accurate filing systems
Support document review processes and assist with organizing electronically stored information (ESI) for investigations and litigation
Coordinate with internal teams including e Discovery, forensic analysts, and project managers on case-related tasks
Schedule meetings, prepare agendas, and maintain calendars for legal professionals
Assist in drafting routine legal correspondence, reports, and administrative documentation
Track case progress, deadlines, and important milestones to ensure timely execution
Maintain confidentiality and handle sensitive legal information with discretion Required Qualifications and Skills
Proven experience as a legal assistant, paralegal support professional, or in a similar legal administrative role
Bachelor's degree in Law, Legal Studies, Business Administration, or a related field
Experience supporting legal, compliance, forensic investigation, financial, or Web3-related matters involving case documentation and administrative coordination
Strong organizational and document management skills with high attention to detail
Ability to manage multiple tasks and deadlines in a fast-paced environment
Excellent written and verbal communication skills
Proficiency in common office and document management software tools
Ability to handle sensitive legal, financial, and investigative information with discretion Additional Preferred Qualifications and Skills
Experience supporting litigation, investigations, or compliance matters preferred
Familiarity with e Discovery processes and legal documentation workflows is advantageous
Knowledge of legal research methods and document review practices is beneficial
Exposure to forensic investigations or regulatory environments is a plus About Gemean
Gemean is a global leader in forensic investigations, electronic discovery, and data analytics. We utilize advanced platforms like Pyth AI and cutting-edge data tools to interpret complex datasets, support legal cases, and fortify organizational compliance and governance. Our multidisciplinary approach enables us to deliver comprehensive, actionable insights tailored to our clients' needs.

title: Portuguese language specialist
description:

you to apply!

Nascemos para simplificar a energia, algo essencial, mas que hoje parece distante e complexo. O brasileiro paga uma das contas de luz mais caras do mundo, muitas vezes sem saber que tem uma escolha. Quando descobre, a complexidade e a falta de transparência do setor geram desconfiança.

A Liora chegou para mudar essa realidade. Nossa missão é provar que é possível ter acesso a uma energia mais barata e limpa com transparência, simplicidade e um atendimento genuinamente humano. Para nós, energia não é um produto técnico, é uma relação de confiança que devolve o poder para quem paga a conta.

Essa transformação é construída por um time obcecado por seus clientes e que busca a excelência em tudo o que faz. Se você busca um propósito, quer construir algo gigante e acredita que o impossível é o nosso ponto de partida, seu lugar é aqui

Sua principal missão será levar a solução da Liora para pequenas e médias empresas e clientes residenciais que mais sentem o impacto da conta de luz no bolso e ainda não sabem que têm uma alternativa melhor.

  • Ajudar clientes a tomar decisões com segurança e clareza.
  • Construir relações de confiança que duram.

Principais Responsabilidades:

  • Desbravar o Mercado: Prospectar ativamente e qualificar novos clientes (PMEs e Residenciais), construindo um pipeline de oportunidades sólido e constante.
  • Desenvolver Parcerias Estratégicas: Mapear, negociar e ativar redes de parceiros que nos ajudem a multiplicar nosso alcance e impacto.

  • Atuar como a Voz do Cliente: Trazer feedbacks valiosos do mercado para colaborar com os times de Produto, Marketing e Pós-venda, nos ajudando a melhorar continuamente.

O que Buscamos em Você:

  • Perfil Hunter: Você tem energia, resiliência e paixão por abrir novas portas e prospectar clientes.
  • Comunicação Excepcional: Habilidade de se comunicar de forma clara, direta e empática, criando conexões genuínas.

E aí, vamos transformar o futuro da energia juntos?

Se você se identificou com a nossa missão e acredita que tem o perfil para este desafio, queremos te conhecer!

#VemPraLiora #EnergiaSimples #Transformação #VendasComPropósito

leadership potentialFeeling up to the task of managing the main challenges of the role, even without meeting all criteria? title: Cybersecurity Project Manager
description:
TheProject Managerin our cybersecurity/IT services division will lead the planning and execution of complex technology projects, ensuring they are deliveredon time, within scope, and within budget. This role acts as a bridge between technical teams (network/security engineers, developers, analysts) and business stakeholders. The Project Manager is responsible for coordinating cross-functional efforts in a dynamic environment, often managingmultiple projectsor client engagements simultaneously, aligning them with strategic goals and the latest industry practices (e.G.,Agile methodology, cloud deployments, security compliance ). Key Responsibilities: Project Planning & Execution:Define projectscope, objectives, and deliverablesfor cybersecurity and IT infrastructure projects. Develop detailed project plans with timelines, milestones, and resource allocation. Manage the full project lifecycle from initiation to closure, adapting to changing requirements or priorities. Team Leadership & Coordination:Lead cross-functional teams (security engineers, IT staff, developers, client representatives) to ensure collaboration and timely task completion. Assign responsibilities, oversee day-to-day project activities, and maintain team motivation and productivity in both on-site andremote/hybrid work environments. Budget & Risk Management:Manage project budgets and control costs. Identify and mitigate risks and issues proactively;
implement contingency plans to address potential project roadblocks or security concerns. Ensure compliance with cybersecurity standards and regulations (e.G., data privacy laws, security policies) throughout project execution. Stakeholder Communication:Serve as the primary contact for internal and external stakeholders. Provide regular project status updates, performance metrics, and risk assessments to clients, senior management, and team members. Facilitate meetings, gather feedback, and manage expectations to maintain alignment with project goals and client needs. Quality Assurance & Delivery:Ensure project deliverables meet the required quality and security standards. Coordinate testing, user acceptance, and security reviews on project outputs (e.G., new system implementations, policy rollouts). Oversee documentation (project plans, reports, compliance evidence) and obtain stakeholder sign-offs. Post-Project Support & Continuous Improvement:Oversee transition of completed projects to operational teams. Conduct post-mortems and lessons-learned sessions to identify improvement opportunities. Stay informed on emergingindustry trends(likeAI integration in project management ,DevSecOps, and newcollaboration tools ) to continually enhance project management practices. Required Qualifications & Skills: Education & Professional Knowledge:Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Business (or related field). Strong understanding ofIT systems, networks, and cybersecurity fundamentalsto effectively communicate with technical teams and align projects with security best practices. Project Management Skills:Proven ability to manage complex IT or security projects usingproject management methodologies(Waterfall and Agile). Proficiency with project management tools (e.G., MS Project, Jira, or Trello) for planning, tracking, and reporting. Skilled in developing project documentation and managing project scope changes. Leadership & Communication:Excellent leadership and organizational skills. Demonstrated experience coordinatingcross-functional teams, managing resources, and resolving conflicts. Exceptional communication skills to interface with diverse stakeholders and present project updates in a clear, concise manner. Analytical & Problem-Solving:Strong risk assessment, problem-solving, and decision-making abilities. Capacity to anticipate challenges, craft mitigation strategies, and adapt to evolving project needs. Must be detail-oriented but also able to see the big picture to ensure projects deliver strategic value. Preferred Qualifications: Advanced Knowledge:Familiarity withcybersecurity frameworks(e.G., NIST CSF, ISO 27001) and regulatory standards (e.G., GDPR, HIPAA) to integrate compliance into project plans. Understanding of modern IT trends such ascloud computing projects, digital transformation, orAI-driven solutionsis a plus. Industry Experience:Prior experience in anIT services or consulting environment, managing projects for external clients or within large enterprise settings. Background innetwork/security infrastructure projectsor software development projects is advantageous. Methodologies:Certifications or hands-on experience withAgile/Scrummethodologies (e.G., Certified Scrum Master) orDevOps/DevSecOpspractices. Experience Requirements: Experience:7+ yearsof experience in project management within the IT or cybersecurity domain. This should include successfully managingmultiple full project lifecycles, with at least several projects related toIT security, networking, or software/IT infrastructure. Leadership experience in a matrixed or cross-functional team environment is essential. Certifications: Project Management Certifications:Project Management Professional (PMP)orPRINCE2(highly preferred / required) as evidence of formal project management training and expertise. Security/Technical Certifications:Certifications such asCertified Information Systems Security Professional (CISSP) ,Certified Information Security Manager (CISM), orCertified Information Systems Auditor (CISA)are a plus, signifying an understanding of cybersecurity principles and compliance. Agile/Other Certs:Additional certifications likeCertified Scrum Master (CSM)orITIL Foundationare beneficial and reflect a commitment to industry best practices.

Olá, somos a SuperFrete :)Queremos ser a maior e mais amada rede de logística digital, quer fazer parte disso?Somos uma startup que atua no segmento do varejo e logística, apoiando os pequenos e médios empreendedores a se tornarem mais competitivos no mercado e a alavancarem suas vendas. Por isso, buscamos um(a)Super Product Owner Pleno, que se identifique com o nosso propósito, que tenha muita energia para somar no time deProdutose que queria crescer (muito!) com a gente.Responsabilidades: Estratégia e visão de produto Contribuir para a definição da visão do produto e alinhamento com stakeholders;
Identificar problemas relevantes e oportunidades de melhoria baseadas em dados e feedback de usuários;
Priorizar iniciativas alinhadas aos OKRs trimestrais.Discovery e validação de soluções Conduzir discovery contínuo para entendimento profundo de problemas e necessidades;
Criar e validar hipóteses de solução antes da implementação em escala;
Construir ou apoiar a construção de MVPs rápidos utilizando ferramentas de IA, prototipação e low-code;
Testar soluções com usuários antes de direcionar o time de engenharia.Gestão do produto e delivery Criar épicos e histórias de usuário bem estruturadas, com critérios de aceite claros;
Gerir backlog upstream e downstream;
Priorizar e refinar demandas com o time de tecnologia;
Orientar o time sobre regras de negócio e objetivos das entregas;
Avaliar e aceitar entregas garantindo aderência aos critérios definidos.Colaboração com o time Trabalhar próximo aos times de UX, Engenharia e Dados;
Participar de rituais do time (dailys, refinamentos, planning e retrospectivas);
Garantir clareza de contexto e objetivos para o time multidisciplinar.Gestão por dados Monitorar métricas de produto e comportamento do usuário;
Utilizar dados para validar hipóteses e apoiar decisões de produto;
Conduzir experimentos (A/B tests, testes de solução, validações rápidas).Requisitos: Experiência sólida atuando como Product Manager ou Product Owner;
Forte habilidade de priorização de backlog;
Experiência com Discovery e Delivery de produto;
Capacidade de estruturar histórias de usuário, critérios de aceite e cenários;
Experiência com metodologias ágeis como Scrum e Kanban;
Experiência com ferramentas de gestão de produto (Jira, Miro ou similares);
Experiência com análisede dados de produto (Amplitude, Mixpanel, Google Analytics, HubSpot ou similares);
Experiência com testes e experimentação em produtos digitais;
Experiência com métricas de produto digital.Diferenciais: Conhecimento em estatística ou ciência de dados;
Noções de arquitetura estacks de tecnologia (backend, web, app, infraestrutura);
Experiência em varejo, e-commerce ou marketplaces;
Experiência em startups;
Experiência com prototipação rápida e ferramentas de construção low-code / IA.O que esperamos dessa pessoa: Forte orientação aresolver problemas reais dos usuários ;
Mentalidadedata-driven ;
Capacidade detomar decisões com autonomia e responsabilidade ;
Perfilmão na massa, confortável em testar soluções rapidamente;
Curiosidade e abertura para trabalhar comIA e novas ferramentas de construção de produto ;
Boa comunicação e capacidade de colaboração com times multidisciplinares.O que você pode esperar dos Supers? Uma cultura de muita confiança, colaboração, focada em resultados, com muita autonomia e transparência;
Buscamos excelência em tudo o que fazemos, por isso estamos sempre aprendendo;
Temos vontade de construir junto, fazer a diferença e gerar impacto.O que oferecemos: Modelo de contratação: PJ;
Modelo de trabalho 100%remoto: uma oportunidade de crescimento acessível para talentos em todo o Brasil;
Plano de Saúde: mantenha-se saudável com nosso abrangente plano de saúde nacional com consultas online e presenciais;
GymPass/Wellhub: bem-estar completo para você cuidar da sua saúde física e mental com os aplicativos integrados;
Voucher Kit Escritório: receba um voucher para turbinar o seu espaço de trabalho e garantir seu conforto, comodidade e produtividade;
Férias remuneradas: desfrute de 30 dias de férias remuneradas por ano para recarregar suas energias e relaxar;
Programa Super-Get-Super: indique um talento e receba um bônus;
Cultura colaborativa: nossa cultura é baseada na confiança, parceria e foco em resultados. Oferecemos um ambiente com autonomia e transparência;
Incentivo ao desenvolvimento: estamos comprometidos com a excelência e o aprendizado contínuo. Oferecemos avaliações semestrais, conversas de one-on-one, feedbacks construtivos, e muito mais.E aí, vamos juntos nesse SuperFoguete?

title: Data Analyst V
description: Título da posição:Data Analyst V BRL Tipo de contratação:Temporário via agência Modelo de trabalho:Home officeVisão Geral da Posição A equipe de Analytics de BMP (Business Model and Pricing) está em busca de um(a) Analista de Dados experiente para apoiar a gestão de performance do negócio e a tomada de decisões estratégicas por meio de análises avançadas. A equipe atua em parceria próxima com liderança, finanças, operações e stakeholders de negócio para mensurar o desempenho das nossas ofertas aos clientes, gerar insights sobre o comportamento dos clientes e impulsionar ações orientadas por dados em toda a organização.O(a) Analista de Dados desempenhará um papel crítico na transformação de dados complexos em insights acionáveis, no desenvolvimento de frameworks analíticos e na viabilização do monitoramento de performance por meio de dashboards, relatórios e análises aprofundadas. Esta função exige forte rigor analítico, visão de negócio e capacidade de comunicar insights de forma clara para stakeholders seniores.O(a) candidato(a) ideal possui histórico comprovado de entrega de análises de alto impacto em ambientes dinâmicos e multifuncionais, além de estar confortável equilibrando análises estruturadas e recorrentes com demandas ad hoc que apoiam prioridades de negócio em constante evolução.O que você fará Aplicar forte mentalidade analítica e de resolução de problemas para identificar questões de negócio, lacunas de performance e oportunidades de melhoria, traduzindo-as em abordagens analíticas claras. Apoiar iniciativas de BMP fornecendo insights sobre performance do negócio, eficiência operacional, direcionadores financeiros e KPIs estratégicos. Projetar, desenvolver e manter dashboards, relatórios e modelos analíticos para acompanhar a performance em relação às metas e apoiar a tomada de decisão da liderança. Conduzir análises ad hoc e aprofundadas para explicar tendências, variações, riscos e oportunidades, além de avaliar o impacto de iniciativas de negócio. Trabalhar em estreita colaboração com stakeholders para entender objetivos, definir métricas relevantes e garantir que as entregas analíticas estejam alinhadas às necessidades de decisão. Atuar em parceria com as equipes de engenharia de dados, finanças e outros times de analytics para garantir qualidade, consistência e escalabilidade das soluções de reporte. Sintetizar análises complexas em narrativas claras e objetivas, apresentando resultados que traduzam dados em insights acionáveis para a liderança sênior. Contribuir para a melhoria contínua de frameworks analíticos, ferramentas e melhores práticas dentro da equipe de BMP Analytics.Qualificações Mínimas Mestrado em Analytics, Ciência de Dados, Economia, Estatística, Engenharia, Administração ou área quantitativa relacionada. Mais de 5 anos de experiência em análise de dados, analytics de negócio ou gestão de performance. Experiência sólida com SQL e pelo menos uma linguagem de programação analítica (Python ou equivalente). Experiência na construção de dashboards e relatórios utilizando ferramentas de BI (preferencialmente Power BI). Forte pensamento analítico, com capacidade comprovada de estruturar problemas ambíguos. Excelentes habilidades de comunicação e apresentação, com capacidade de engajar públicos técnicos e não técnicos. Capacidade comprovada de colaboração eficaz em equipes multifuncionais. Inglês fluente.Qualificações Desejáveis Experiência com análises financeiras ou de gestão de performance de negócios. Familiaridade com técnicas analíticas avançadas (previsão, análise estatística, modelagem de cenários). Experiência com ambientes de dados em nuvem (ex.: AWS). Experiência com pipelines de dados, automação ou ferramentas de orquestração (ex.: Airflow). Experiência com big data ou frameworks de processamento distribuído (ex.: Spark / PySpark). Experiência em organização global matricial.

title: Technical Product Manager (Temporary Contract)
description: About You You are a technically fluent, execution-oriented professional who thrives at the intersection of product, engineering, and stakeholder management. You communicate clearly, operate independently, and bring empathy to every interaction.You are proactive and solution-oriented. You identify problems, define solutions, and drive them forward in fast-paced Agile environments. You actively leverage AI tools as part of your daily workflow to improve productivity and delivery outcomes.You feel comfortable owning a product backlog, onboarding API partners, presenting to a Change Advisory Board, and collaborating directly with clients to troubleshoot issues. You connect teams, drive accountability, and ensure initiatives move forward successfully.Note:This position is offered under a contractor model for a period of 6 months.You Bring to Applaudo the Following Competencies: Strong fluency in Agile and Scrum, including backlog ownership, sprint ceremonies, user story writing, and acceptance criteria definition. Strong product ownership mindset, with the ability to prioritize effectively, champion quality, and drive the Definition of Done. Proven ability to act as a liaison between engineering teams, business stakeholders, and external technology partners. Excellent technical communication skills, translating business requirements into technical language for audiences at all levels. Working knowledge of REST APIs, JSON, and authentication concepts, including error handling, log review, and defect triage. Hands-on experience with Jira or Azure DevOps for backlog management, issue tracking, and release coordination. Strong documentation skills covering requirements, epics, user stories, workflows, and integration touchpoints. Active user of AI tools and copilots, with a practical focus on improving workflows and engineering productivity. Highly self-managed, with strong ownership and proactive risk identification across concurrent initiatives. Strong empathy and curiosity for customer and partner problems, with a practical and solution-oriented mindset. Advanced English proficiency with conversational fluency to collaborate effectively with US-based stakeholders.You Will Be Accountable for the Following Responsibilities: Own and maintain a well-groomed product backlog, writing user stories and acceptance criteria aligned with business needs. Lead cross-functional project delivery and serve as the team's single point of accountability for quality and progress. Act as the primary coordination point between internal engineering teams and external API or integration partners. Translate business and partner requirements into clear functional and technical specifications. Manage intake, triage, prioritization, and assignment of technical issues, defects, and enhancement requests. Support onboarding of API and integration partners, including requirements gathering, environment setup, testing, and go-live. Facilitate Agile ceremonies and cross-functional working sessions with internal and external teams. Collaborate with engineering teams to analyze logs, error reports, and support tickets to diagnose and resolve issues. Deliver weekly status reports to stakeholders covering milestones, risks, and blockers. Present change requests to the Change Advisory Board (CAB). Coordinate and support UAT and partner validation activities. Track delivery progress, dependencies, and risks across multiple concurrent initiatives. Provide direct user support when required, including troubleshooting, feature walkthroughs, and discovery sessions. Leverage AI tools to improve workflows, documentation quality, and delivery speed. Identify opportunities to improve onboarding, support, and issue management processes through standardization and automation.Qualifications Hands-on experience with Jira or Azure DevOps for backlog management, sprint planning, and issue tracking. Working knowledge of REST APIs, JSON, and integration concepts, with the ability to support partner onboarding and triage technical issues. Proven ability to write user stories, acceptance criteria, and technical documentation for cross-functional engineering teams. Advanced English proficiency with conversational fluency to collaborate effectively with US-based stakeholders.Additional Information About UsWe Are Engineered Different. At Applaudo, talented people design, build, and scale meaningful, AI-powered solutions that create real business impact. As an AI-native organization, we collaborate across design, development, cloud, data, and artificial intelligence to turn ideas into scalable products that transform how companies operate, make decisions, and grow.We are building a high-performance culture grounded in five values:Empowering Excellence, Collaborative Teamwork, Unsolicited Respect, Consistent Transparency, and Efficient Communication. These define how we work, how we support one another, and how we hold ourselves accountable.Applaudo is a place for people who want to learn fast, take ownership, and work alongside strong teams they are proud to belong to. Joining us means being part of an organization that is evolving intentionally, investing in modern ways of working, and leading AI-native transformation at scale.

title: Manager, Corporate Development - M&A Origination & Deal Sourcing
description: Gemini Group (csigemini.Com) is part of Constellation Software Inc. (TSX: CSU), a global acquirer, builder, and manager of vertical market software businesses. Gemini partners with high-quality software companies, providing long-term operational support, capital, and strategic guidance to help them grow sustainably. Our portfolio spans multiple vertical markets and operates through decentralized business units that are deeply embedded in their respective industries. Learn more here: csigemini.ComThe Role The Manager, Corporate Development will play a critical role in identifying, building, and nurturing strategic relationships that lead to new acquisition opportunities for Gemini Group.In this role, you will engage with software company leaders. Your success will be measured by your ability to cultivate meaningful, trust-based relationships that ultimately result in Gemini acquiring high-quality software businesses. Relationship-building in this role is a long-term endeavor - often taking multiple years from first contact to acquisition. Success requires persistence, strategic thinking, disciplined pipeline management, high-quality market research, and a consistent ability to add value across many conversations.As Gemini continues to expand its presence globally, this Brazil based role will also play a foundational part in helping scale Gemini's M&A capability in the LATAM market. Over time, the Manager, Corporate Development will have the opportunity to contribute to the growth of a localized M&A function - including shaping best practices and helping establish Gemini as a preferred partner for LATAM software entrepreneurs. This is a unique chance to be a builder of Gemini's deal-sourcing footprint in Brazil while advancing your own leadership trajectory within the organization.Key Outcomes Develop, manage, and expand an M&A pipeline using Salesforce CRM, including market mapping within assigned software verticals. Meet and exceed weekly and quarterly sourcing and relationship-building KPIs. Work both independently and in collaboration with Gemini's M&A leadership to efficiently evaluate potential acquisition opportunities. Ensure accurate categorization and allocation of leads within relevant portfolio verticals. Effectively screen and qualify opportunities at the top of the acquisition funnel to support Portfolio Managers and operating teams. Support the long-term build-out of Gemini's LATAM/Brazil M&A presence by contributing to sourcing processes, knowledge sharing, and future team development. Engage directly with founders, CEOs, and controlling shareholders, conducting high-quality M&A conversations to understand ownership dynamics, M&A insights, motivations, business insights and timing of a future, potential deal. Qualify opportunities through initial commercial, operational, and financial assessment, filtering deals before internal escalation. Coordinate internally with global teams (Perseus / CSI) to align on pipeline prioritization and strategic fit. Maintain structured tracking of interactions and insights (CRM-driven), ensuring continuity and depth of relationship over time.Relevant Experience & Competencies At least three years of experience in M&A business development, with proven involvement in various aspects of M&A such as mandate origination (including private equity), initial contact with key decision-makers, deal negotiation, or client-facing roles in M&A or finance within the software or technology sector. Experience in outbound deal origination planning. Previous exposure on relationship-building meetings (virtual or in-person) with company owners to explore strategic M&A opportunities. Demonstrated interest in building a long-term career in software investing, M&A, or corporate development. Track record of high performance in business development, entrepreneurship, or other competitive environments. Strong executive presence with the ability to confidently engage senior leaders, including CEOs, investors, and advisors. Highly organized, detail-oriented, and comfortable working autonomously. Self-motivated, proactive, and results-driven with a strong sense of urgency.Other Requirements Willingness to travel occasionally within Brazil and broader LATAM as well as internationally to Canada, the U.S., and Portugal. Professional working proficiency in both English and Portuguese is required. Professional working proficiency in Spanish is a bonus.

title: Research Engineer, Multimodal
description:
The Role We are looking for aResearch Engineer, Multimodalto help deliver frontier-quality multimodal datasets, evaluations, and RL environments that improve state-of-the-art models for leading AI labs and enterprise clients.This is a hands-on, research-facing technical role. You will work directly with customer researchers and engineers to turn their multimodal model improvement goals into concrete data specs — designing tasks that test genuine cross-modal reasoning, not just text comprehension with images attached.We're targeting candidates with roughly 4–5 years of experience building or improving multimodal AI systems — especially where strong results depended on data curation across modalities, evaluation design, or building systems that handle the complexity of real-world documents, charts, and visual interfaces.What You'll Do 1. Design and deliver multimodal datasets and evaluation environments Work with customer researchers to define data requirements for multimodal capabilities: chart reading, document QA, UI understanding, diagram-based reasoning, OCR-aware tasks, and visual grounding. Design task suites that test true multimodal reasoning — tasks where the answer requires integrating information across text, images, tables, and document structure, not just surface-level pattern matching. Build ground-truth signals and verification systems for multimodal tasks, where correctness often depends on spatial relationships, visual context, and cross-reference between modalities. Define task formats and data schemas that capture the full richness of multimodal inputs while remaining tractable for model training.2. Build quality and validation systems for multimodal data Perform deep audits of produced data — spotting subtle errors in visual grounding, incorrect chart readings, OCR artifacts, layout misinterpretations, and ambiguous visual references. Implement automated validation: consistency checks across modalities, format and schema validation, deduplication, and difficulty/diversity controls. Where appropriate, develop synthetic data generation pipelines: programmatic chart/table generation, document layout templating, controlled visual perturbations, and augmentation across visual conditions. 3. Prove impact through evaluations and training runs Design and run evals targeting multimodal capabilities aligned with customer goals. Produce analysis connecting data to outcomes: pre/post comparisons on targeted multimodal tasks, error breakdowns by modality and task type, and ablations identifying which data attributes drive model lift. When needed, run fine-tuning or RL experiments (or partner with research) to demonstrate measurable multimodal improvement. 4. Collaborate with cross-functional delivery teams Provide clear specs, visual examples, and edge cases to engineers, QAs, domain SMEs, and data production groups. Run fast feedback loops grounded in multimodal quality metrics. Review and improve outputs from large-scale multimodal data creation efforts, maintaining a high bar for cross-modal correctness and realism.Who We're Looking For 1. Required Qualifications 4–5 years of experience building or improving AI systems involving multimodal data — images, documents, charts, tables, or visual interfaces combined with text. Hands-on experience with at least one of: document understanding, chart/diagram reasoning, OCR systems, UI understanding, or vision-language models. Strong intuition for what makes a good multimodal task: genuine cross-modal reasoning requirements, clear ground truth, and resistance to text-only shortcuts. Demonstrated ability to be extremely detail-oriented — you catch when a chart label is misread, a table cell is misaligned, or a visual reference is ambiguous. Python proficiency required;
comfort with SQL and structured data workflows strongly preferred. Ability to communicate clearly with researchers and engineers — turning multimodal model goals into concrete data specs.2. Highly valued experience RL or post-training experience: RLHF/RLAIF, reward modeling, verifier training, or environment design applied to multimodal tasks. Experience with vision-language models (CLIP, LLaVA, GPT-4V, Gemini, or equivalent). Agentic evaluation involving visual grounding: browser-use agents, UI navigation, or screen-based task completion. Experience building evaluation frameworks or benchmarks for multimodal systems. Audio/video understanding experience (optional but valued).Why Turing Work directly with the world's leading AI labs on the multimodal datasets and evaluations training the next generation of vision-language models. Real impact: your data will directly shape how models learn to read charts, understand documents, navigate interfaces, and reason across modalities. Talent-dense team with high autonomy, rapid iteration, and an exceptional learning curve.Why Turing Work directly with the world's leading AI labs on the RL environments powering post-training for frontier models. Real impact: your environments and reward systems will directly shape how models learn to reason, act, and improve. Talent-dense team with high autonomy, rapid iteration, and an exceptional learning curve.Values: We are client first : We put our clients at the center of everything we do, because their success is the ultimate measure of our value. We work at Start-Up Speed:We move fast, stay agile and favor action because momentum is the foundation of perfection We are Al forward:We help our clients build the future of Al and implement it in our own roles and workflow to amplify productivity.Advantages of joining Turing: Amazing work culture (Super collaborative & supportive work environment;
5 days a week) Awesome colleagues (Surround yourself with top talent from Meta, Google, LinkedIn etc. as well as people with deep startup experience) Competitive compensation Flexible working hoursDon't meet every single requirement? Studies have shown that women and people of color are less likely to apply to jobs unless they meet every single qualification. Turing is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, age, marital status, disability, protected veteran status, or any other legally protected characteristics. At Turing we are dedicated to building a diverse, inclusive and authentic workplace and celebrate authenticity, so if you're excited about this role but your past experience doesn't align perfectly with every qualification in the job description, we encourage you to apply anyways. You may be just the right candidate for this or other roles.For applicants from the European Union, please review Turing's GDPR notice here.

title: Gerente De Investigação Forense
description: Este grupo multinacional líder, com operações significativas nas Américas e em todo o mundo, busca um Gerente de Investigação Forense experiente para liderar uma equipe de investigadores corporativos em suas operações regionais.Sediado em Belo Horizonte, você será responsável por gerir uma equipe de especialistas forenses e supervisionar investigações de crimes financeiros complexos, incluindo conflitos de interesse, fraudes em compras e suprimentos, apropriação indébita de ativos, má gestão financeira, corrupção e suborno.Sua função será focada primordialmente na liderança da equipe, definindo objetivos estratégicos de desempenho e construindo relacionamentos para garantir a fluidez das operações regionais. Você terá a responsabilidade diária pela gestão dos especialistas forenses, fornecendo orientação para o desenvolvimento de carreira e supervisionando a alocação de recursos. Além disso, você será o principal ponto de contato para a gestão operacional, desempenhando um papel fundamental na estratégia geral dos objetivos de investigação do grupo.Somado às funções de liderança, você conduzirá projetos de investigação corporativa de alto nível, ministrará treinamentos de conscientização sobre fraudes e supervisionará a integração de ferramentas de análise de dados (data analytics) nos fluxos de trabalho investigativos.Para ter sucesso nesta função, é fundamental possuir sólida experiência na condução de investigações corporativas complexas e na gestão de equipes forenses especializadas. Provavelmente, você já atua em um cargo de gerência em uma consultoria forense ou em uma função similar no setor corporativo. Embora a certificação CFE seja muito bem-vinda, valorizamos sua capacidade comprovada de liderar equipes de alto desempenho e gerenciar o relacionamento com stakeholders seniores.Excelentes habilidades de comunicação são essenciais, sendo obrigatória a fluência em português e inglês. Conhecimento em espanhol e experiência com ferramentas avançadas de análise de dados serão considerados diferenciais significativosPara mais informações, assista ao nossovideo

title: Brand & Copy Strategist
description: Hey, Dingus!Yep—you read that right. Dingus & Zazzy is expanding, and we're on the hunt for a Brand & Copy Strategist!About UsDingus & Zazzy is a global digital marketing agency helping brands grow across every corner of the digital landscape. We offer an "unlimited get-shit-done" subscription for our clients—from websites to social to SEO and everything in between.Our team is full of creatives, strategists, tech geeks, and builders who love making brands look, feel, and perform better online. If that sounds like your vibe, keep reading.Purpose of This PositionAs a Brand & Copy Strategist, you are responsible for writing and owning all copy for the clients within your squad, ensuring that every word reflects the brand's voice, positioning, and intent. You ensure that every piece of written content across websites, social media, email, and campaigns is on-brand, intentional, and delivered at a high standard. You bring together copywriting, brand awareness, practical content direction, strategy, and project management to ensure brands are represented clearly and consistently through words.You act as the bridge between brand intent and execution, translating client goals and direction into clear, purposeful copy that is ready for internal review and client delivery.Core ResponsibilityServe as the owner of brand representation through copy for your squad's clients. Your accountability is defined by the following questions: "Is this copy clear, on-brand, purposeful, and strong enough to confidently move forward?"\ "Is this project timeline possible with the resources we have for proper execution?"Main Objectives1. Content Execution & Copywriting Write high-quality, purpose-driven copy for: -Websites -Social media captions and post copy -Email campaigns -Campaign and promotional assets Design-related copy (headlines, CTAs, supporting text) Act as the primary writer for all copy deliverables within your squad. Ensure every piece of copy is written with intention, clarity, and audience awareness. Perform copyediting on your own work to maintain consistency, grammatical excellence, and brand alignment, using tools and peers as needed.2. Strategy & Project Management Create social media strategies for your clients based on their goals and audiences Keep track of client feedback and apply them to future work Plan content in batches for the month, ensuring: -Consistency in writing style -Variety in content types -A range of related, engaging topics3. Social Media Copy & Content Direction Develop and write social media copy that reflects the brand's voice and messaging. When appropriate, define content themes and messaging direction for social platforms. When deeper strategy or clarity is required, collaborate with Special Teams to receive social content strategy support or plans. Execute all social media copy in alignment with the strategy you create and flag any gaps or unclear direction early.4. Creative Collaboration & Brand Consistency Participate in brainstorming and ideation sessions to help define the content, messaging, and assets required for campaigns and initiatives. Provide copy-led input on creative direction to ensure consistency of brand voice, messaging, and intent across all touchpoints. Collaborate with designers, Marketing Coordinators, and Account Managers to align written and visual assets under a cohesive brand narrative. Contribute perspective beyond copy when needed to maintain brand clarity and consistency.5. Brand Advocacy Act as the copy owner for each assigned brand, ensuring consistent voice, tone, and messaging across all written content. Apply brand guidelines and positioning directly within copy execution. Review copy deliverables to ensure they meet internal quality standards and accurately represent the brand's intent.Reporting Relationship This role reports to the designated Account Manager of your squad.Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)1. Brand Alignment & Copy Effectiveness Ensure all copy deliverables are consistently aligned with the brand's voice, tone, and messaging. Maintain minimal client revisions related to brand alignment, tone, or clarity. Contribute social content ideas and messaging angles when needed, ensuring alignment with the brand's voice, positioning, and goals. Collaborate cross-functionally to ensure brand consistency across copy and supporting assets.2. Content Quality & Accuracy Deliver copy that meets internal quality standards for clarity, structure, and purpose. Maintain a low rate of client dissatisfaction related to copy quality or intent.3. Project Delivery Timeliness Deliver copy-related tasks within agreed timelines. Collaborate with the squad to support smooth handoffs and on-time delivery of content assets.Work Details Hours: 9 A.M. – 5 P.M. MST, Monday to Friday Requires a working level of written and spoken EnglishReady for the ride of your life? Apply now!

title: Risk Control Analyst
description: Job Responsibilities Investigate and analyze various risk behaviors, includingfraud, phishing, and account theft, and take appropriate actions to reduce user losses and improve user satisfaction. Detect data anomalies throughrisk management and real-time monitoring, and coordinate with relevant teams to prevent potential losses.
